title.en: An Act Converting the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office Located in the Municipality of Rosales, Province of Pangasinan into a Regular LTO District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office Located in the Municipality of Rosales, Province of Pangasinan into a Regular LTO District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Văn phòng mở rộng Land Transportation Office thành Văn phòng Khu vực Regular LTO tại Đô thị Rosales, Tỉnh Pangasinan, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะสำนักงานขยาย Land Transportation Office เป็น สำนักงานเขต Regular LTO ในเทศบาล Rosales จังหวัด Pangasinan และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Kantor Perluasan Land Transportation Office menjadi Kantor Distrik Regular LTO di Kotamadya Rosales, Provinsi Pangasinan, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu

text.en: The existing Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office located in the Municipality of Rosales, Province of Pangasinan, is hereby converted into a regular LTO district office to be known as the LTO-Rosales District Office.

The Secretary of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the LTO-Rosales District Office, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the LTO-Rosales Extension Office. Thereafter, such sums as may he necessary for the continued operation of the LTO-Rosales District Office shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
